race.comment: ALEBRIJE (4) missed by 0.6L last time out in a better performance out to this track and trip. She now gets Faithfull third-up into the campaign and she looks poised to strike. Finds the right race and can land the knockout blow. MORF (1) improved quickly last start to get the job done by 1.4L as he dropped in grade. Carries the big weight here from a wide draw, but is a classy type with a handy resume and he can't be discounted. DEEPLY ROOTED (3) got the job done in a photo finish last start over 1300m. The claim of Cheung comes in handy and he's a track and trip winner in the past. Can land the knockout blow. DANCEWITHME (2) is hard to knock on her recent form and has to be included. VIRESHA (7) won't be far away.
